# EDEN Support-kit module

Fill in the table, write your module below it, then move this Doc into the ready folder. You don't need GitHub or Markdown.

# How it works

1. Make your own copy: File \> Make a copy. Name it after your module.  
2. Fill in the yellow cells of the table in your own words. Replace the text in \[square brackets\]; leave a row as it is if it doesn't apply. Not sure what to write? See the [reference sheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1my8JDbFFWFeltbuJhs8rQIlhDCw_4_E0WXPYGQWOJEU/edit).  
3. Write under Module content. Use Google Docs headings and bullet lists. Comment and suggest with colleagues as usual.  
4. When it is ready, set Status to Ready and move this Doc into the folder [EDEN Support-kit – ready for the kit](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qTIuQq-G62Bf6-CZgTxH-C4KevIcWnGI).  
5. Within the hour you get a comment here with a link to the review. Keep editing this Doc; your changes update the review.

# Module metadata

| Field | Value | How to fill it |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Title** | Checking file formats on ingest | Required. Task first, under 8 words. Example: Preparing deposits |
| **Description** | \[One sentence\] | Shown on cards and in search results. |
| **Who is it for** | Repository manager | Required. Pick one. |
| **I want to** | \[what the reader wants to do\] | Required. Lower case. Example: prepare my files for deposit |
| **So that** | \[why it matters to them\] | Required. The benefit; say something the title does not. |
| **Kind of help** | How-to | Required. How-to: steps to get a task done. Tutorial: learn by doing. Reference: facts to look up. Explanation: background and why. |
| **Main processes** | 8, file format validation | Required. The WP1 Core Preservation Processes this module mainly teaches. Names or numbers, separated by commas, e.g. “file format validation, 8”. All 30 are listed in the [reference sheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1my8JDbFFWFeltbuJhs8rQIlhDCw_4_E0WXPYGQWOJEU/edit). |
| **Other processes** | \[optional\] | Other processes the reader also touches. |
| **Frameworks** | \[optional\] | For example: CoreTrustSeal R14; nestor. Separate with semicolons. |
| **Keywords** | \[optional\] | A few words for search, separated by commas. |
| **Related modules** | \[optional\] | Titles of other kit modules. |
| **Contributors** | \[your name\] | Required. Type @ to pick people, or write names. |
| **Status** | Draft | Change to Ready when you move the Doc. |
